---
title: "ibm_verify_events_transformed.events_adaptive_risk_summary"
description: "Daily adaptive access evaluations by risk level."
---

Daily counts of IBM Verify adaptive access evaluations, by the risk level IBM
Verify assigned.

Each row is one day. The figures match the top-stats bar on IBM Verify's
"Adaptive access" dashboard.

`Keywords`: adaptive access, risk, risk level, security, fraud, bots, policy

## Provenance

Built from [`adaptive_access`](../ibm_verify_events_raw/adaptive_access.qmd) by
`compute_adaptive_risk_summary()` in the [daily metrics
job](https://github.com/cds-snc/canadalogin-reporting-data-pipeline/blob/main/infra/modules/ibm_verify_events_streaming/glue_src/ibm_verify_events_metrics_daily.py).

Adaptive access went live on 2026-09-09. Rows from 2026-04-22 to 2026-09-08 are
all zero.

* **Updated**: Daily, at 04:00 ET, for the previous ET day
* **Retention**: While CanadaLogin exists
* **Steward**: EDCP Data and Research Team
* **Contact**: [Yinlin Zhang](mailto:yinlin.zhang@cds-snc.ca)
* **Location**: `s3://<transformed-bucket>/ibm_verify_metrics/events_adaptive_risk_summary/`

## Fields

One row per day.

| Field Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| from_date | string | The reporting day in ET, for example "2026-09-15". Cast before comparing to a date |
| to_date | string | Same as `from_date` |
| total_invocations | bigint | Every adaptive access evaluation that day, including those with no risk level |
| very_high_count | bigint | Evaluations rated "VERY_HIGH" |
| high_count | bigint | Evaluations rated "HIGH" |
| medium_count | bigint | Evaluations rated "MEDIUM" |
| low_count | bigint | Evaluations rated "LOW" |
| fetched_at | string | When the job wrote the row, in ISO 8601 UTC |
| date | string | Partition key. Same as `from_date` |

## Notes

**The four levels do not add up to `total_invocations`.** Some evaluations have
no risk level, almost all with the policy action
`ACTION_REDIRECT`. They count in the total only.
